development of a framework for cost of reactive energy for generators in deregulated electricity market.
the development of a framework for cost of reactive energy supported by generators.

the present reactive energy tariff is not a market-based mechanism and is not a true representation of the cost of reactive energy.
the present reactive energy tariff structure is not a good one and it needs to be revised to reflect the actual cost of reactive power.
the present reactive energy pricing scheme in India is not a market based mechanism.

, a frame work for the cost of reactive energy is developed for a generator participating in a dynamic reactive energy allocation process.

a framework has been proposed to account the cost of reactive energy supported by generators during the operation outside prescribed power factor range and to allocate the cost of reactive power to the consumers in the deregulated electricity market.

the reactive energy cost should be allocated to the generators on the basis of their participation in the reactive power market.
the reactive energy tariff is not a flat rate tariff.
